verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that Lithic's Auth Rules engine has a 'digital wallet and merchant tokenization' event stream for decisioning. That implies cards can be tokenized into wallets, but nothing here describes how cards actually get into Apple Pay or Google Pay. Missing for 10: push provisioning from the developer's app, documentation of the Apple/Google entitlements process, in-wallet card art configuration, explicit manual provisioning support, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
